# Blue Ribbon Professional Network

> Blue Ribbon Professional Network (BRPN) is a no-cost, exclusive professional networking group serving Roseville, Rocklin, Lincoln, Loomis, Granite Bay, and the greater Sacramento region of California. Each member represents a different area of expertise (one seat per field), so members collaborate instead of competing. The group's motto is "Know. Like. Trust." and its tagline is "Connect. Collaborate. Grow."

Key facts:

- Cost to attend: free ($0).
- Meetings: twice a month. In person on the 2nd Thursday (Douglas Blvd., Roseville) and on Zoom on the 4th Thursday. Email for the meeting location or link.
- Membership: one member per area of expertise. Visitors are welcome. Professionals in a field not yet represented can connect with any current member or email the group.
- Contact: blueribbonprofessionalnetwork@gmail.com
- Social: [Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/474509884662298), [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/blueribbonprofessionalnetwork/), [LinkedIn group](https://www.linkedin.com/groups/14619310/)

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.blueribbonprofessionalnetwork.com/): Who BRPN is, how it works, and the areas of expertise represented

## Member profile pages

- [Mark Teran — Your Mortgage Man](https://www.blueribbonprofessionalnetwork.com/mark-teran-your-mortgage-man.html): Residential Mortgage Advisor with American Pacific Mortgage (NMLS #285538) and BRPN co-founder. In the mortgage industry since 1986. Purchase loans, refinancing, HELOCs, down payment assistance, buy-before-you-sell, self-employed borrowers, divorce mortgage guidance, and reverse mortgages. Serves Sacramento, Placer, and El Dorado counties, plus clients throughout California and Nevada.
- [Marisela Bennett — Mari Hypnosis](https://www.blueribbonprofessionalnetwork.com/marisela-bennett-mari-hypnosis.html): Certified Clinical Hypnotherapist and Hypnosis Motivation Institute (HMI) graduate. Hypnotherapy for anxiety, motivation, self-esteem, goal setting, habits, fears and phobias, smoking cessation, and weight loss. Ages 9 to 100+, with local, national, and international clients. Free initial consultations.
- [Niki Dawson — Creative Crafting Academy & TaylorMade Web Creations](https://www.blueribbonprofessionalnetwork.com/niki-dawson-creative-crafting-academy-taylormade-web-creations.html): Founder of TaylorMade Web Creations (web design, graphic design, SEO, social media, and marketing since 2000) and Creative Crafting Academy (beginner-friendly mosaic and mixed-media craft classes in Placer County, founded 2026).
